title: Outstanding Oily French Broad Bean Stir Fry
description: A simple Chinese-inspired stir fry dish using French broad beans and a variety of flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the French broad beans and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to tenderize.
Add the pot au feu broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, or until the broad beans are tender but still crisp.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sesame oil if desired.
